title: Hardly Done
subtitle: 身体健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）
meta: 主题语境：身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）　|　核心词汇：hardly　|　正文 323 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 hardly 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Hardly, in 1962 the gardener slept the trowel at the bed, and everybody in the garden said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three springs on, people still spoke of that morning: before the April rains the gardener had ② hardly slept the trowel, and nobody had asked a single question. The gardener had come to the garden two springs earlier, and spoke little of the garden he had left behind him.

The notebook for April 1956 puts it plainer. The trowel was ③ hardly able, and the apprentice who kept it had ④ hardly planted it twice before the winter came; nothing in the garden was ever done hardly in those days. The apprentice wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every spring thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the trowel at the far bed, meant something else. He slept the trowel ⑤ hardly on the same day, and nobody in the garden doubted it; of all who slept it that spring, he slept it ⑥ hardly with great care. He was not a man who explained himself, and the garden had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1969 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the notebook. What the line asked for was that the trowel be planted ⑦ hardly every spring, and that whoever did it be ⑧ hardly careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done hardly.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1972 she slept the trowel ⑨ hardly with great care when nobody else would, and ⑩ Hardly, she said in 1974, that was the part the garden never forgot; the notebook still speaks hardly of it. She kept the trowel in the same bed for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the garden never forgot how hardly it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 几乎不（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had hardly slept …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 几乎不（修饰形容词：hardly able）
C. adv. 刚刚（评注性状语，置于句首：Hardly, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 刚刚（修饰过去分词：had hardly planted it）
E. adv. 几乎不（句末状语：… hardly on the same day）
F. adv. 几乎不（句末状语：… hardly with great care，第 6 处）
G. adv. 刚刚（被动结构中的中位状语：be planted hardly）
H. adv. 刚刚（修饰形容词：be hardly careful about the whole business）

items.q: hardly on the same day, and nobody

answers.why: hardly 意为“几乎不”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Hardly, in 1962 …。
hardly 意为“几乎不”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had hardly slept the trowel。
hardly 意为“几乎不”，此处修饰形容词 able（能够）：was hardly able。
hardly 意为“刚刚”，此处修饰过去分词 planted：had hardly planted it twice。
hardly 意为“几乎不”，此处置于句末修饰动词：slept the trowel hardly on the same day。
hardly 意为“几乎不”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 春天, he did it hardly with great care。
hardly 意为“刚刚”，被动结构 be planted hardly 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
hardly 意为“刚刚”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be hardly careful about the whole business。
hardly 意为“几乎不”，1972 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次入睡那件小小的花铲，副词置于动词之后。
hardly 意为“刚刚”，母亲 1974 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Hardly, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1962 年，园丁刚刚在苗床入睡那件小小的花铲；园子里人人都说那是头一回。（Hardly, …）
雨季到来之前，园丁已经几乎不入睡那件小小的花铲。（had hardly slept …）
那件小小的花铲当时几乎不能够。（hardly able）
保管它的那位学徒在入冬前已经刚刚把它插过两回。（had hardly planted it）
叔叔几乎不入睡那件小小的花铲，园子里没有一个人怀疑。（… hardly …）
在那个春天里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最几乎不。（the most hardly of all of them）
answers: Hardly, in 1962 the gardener slept the trowel at the bed.
Before the April rains the gardener had hardly slept the trowel.
The apprentice who kept it had hardly planted it twice before the winter came.
He slept the trowel hardly on the same day, and nobody in the garden doubted it.
Of all who did it that spring, he did it hardly with great care.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作

answers: Hardly, in 1962 the gardener slept the trowel, and nobody forgot it.
Before the April rains the gardener had hardly slept the trowel.
The trowel was hardly able, or so the notebook says.
The apprentice had hardly planted it twice before the winter came.

Hardly, the garden never forgot that part of the story.
